# Tectonic paper compiler

Noctua distributes Tectonic 0.17.0, an MIT-licensed TeX engine derived from XeTeX,
TeX Live, and other open-source components. See LICENSE and the upstream source
for component-specific notices and licenses.

- Pinned source: https://github.com/tectonic-typesetting/tectonic/tree/tectonic%400.17.0
- Binary releases: https://github.com/tectonic-typesetting/tectonic/releases/tag/tectonic%400.17.0
- Documentation: https://tectonic-typesetting.github.io/book/latest/

The setup script verifies pinned archive SHA-256 checksums before extracting the
executable. TeX support files downloaded by the engine retain their own licenses.
